card.name: Day counts and daily schedules
card.fires_on: Numbers or small words right before "days" or "day" in dosing schedules, such as the 4 in "14 days" or "four" in "three to four days". It also fires on words in phrases like "a day" or "the same three days".

modes.label: Digit in day ranges
modes.description: The last digit of a number like 14 in a table of treatment durations, right before "days".

modes.label: Spelled-out or linking word before day
modes.description: A number word or small word that comes just before "day" or "days" in a frequency phrase.

modes.label: Daily frequency in general text
modes.description: A word inside a phrase meaning once per day, in non-label web text.
modes.example: Drink more water throughout<< the>> day.

card.writes: It pushes against weekday names such as Tuesday and Friday, so the next word is more likely "day" or "days" than a named weekday.
card.plain: It spots the spot just before the word "days" in schedules like "every 14 days" or "once a day".
